meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的token用量和节省成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想实时掌握当前会话的token用量与成本节省。
copy.tagline_en: See real token usage and estimated savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep an eye on how many tokens your session uses and how much it saves.

howto.what: 输入 /caveman-stats 后，界面会直接显示当前会话的真实 token 用量、预估节省、规则开销与净节省；数据直接从会话日志读取，不是 AI 估算。
howto.when: 当你输入斜杠命令 /caveman-stats 时触发。

say.note: 立即显示本会话的 token 用量与节省数字。
输出结果相同，并附带开销明细。

howto.what_en: After typing /caveman-stats, the UI shows real token usage, estimated savings, rule overhead, and net savings for the current session; data comes straight from the session log, not AI estimation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type the slash command /caveman-stats.

say_en.note: Shows token usage and savings for this session.
